description: This PHP source file defines the SchedulerMigrationService class, which manages the migration of scheduler jobs from legacy Google Calendar sync functions to a new unified calendar sync system within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for validation, finding legacy schedulers, checking for existing new schedulers, executing migrations (with dry-run support), and retrieving migration status.

classes.name: SchedulerMigrationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for migrating legacy Google Calendar scheduler jobs to a new calendar sync system within SuiteCRM. It provides validation, discovery, migration, and status reporting functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database and logger dependencies for the service.

methods.name: validateSchedulerMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the necessary database table and scheduler class are available; returns issues if any.

methods.name: findLegacyGoogleSyncSchedulers
methods.description: Retrieves existing legacy schedulers that use 'syncGoogleCalendar' function for migration.

methods.name: hasNewCalendarSyncScheduler
methods.description: Determines if a new calendar sync scheduler already exists to avoid duplication.

methods.name: migrateScheduler
methods.description: Performs the migration of legacy schedulers to the new system; supports dry-run mode.

methods.name: getSchedulerMigrationStatus
methods.description: Provides a summary of current migration status, counting legacy schedulers and presence of new scheduler.
